title: AI Internal Delivery Platform
objective: Build a minimal AI-driven internal delivery platform for automating work orders
scope: Backend API, orchestration layer, approval workflow, audit trail
constraints: Must run locally without external API keys for baseline operation
Must support approval gates for external API calls
Must retain project state across server restarts when using SQLite backend
success_criteria: Audit trail records all actor decisions
State persists after server restart with STATE_BACKEND=sqlite
assumptions: Dev auth tokens are sufficient for local validation
mock trend provider is acceptable for baseline testing
raw_request: Build an AI internal delivery platform with approval workflow and persistent state
